name: Prompt
summary: Text input node for AI generation prompts. Can optionally define a variable name for use in PromptConstructor templates.

outputs.description: The prompt text string, optionally tagged with a variableName for template substitution

executionNotes: A data source node that stores a text prompt and optional variable name. When a variableName is set, the output can be interpolated into PromptConstructor templates using @variableName syntax.

exampleConnections.scenario: Connect prompt directly to image generation node
Use prompt with a variableName as input to a template-based prompt builder
